title: Rate of Return to Sport After Total Knee Prosthesis: Comparison of Three Types of Prostheses
official: Rate of Return to Sport After Total Knee Prosthesis: Comparison of Three Different Types of Prostheses (Medial Pivot, Medial Bearing and Cruciate Retaining)
summary: The purpose of the study is the rate of return to sport (regardless of the sport envisaged) after a minimum of 3 years after total knee prosthesis.
sponsor: GCS Ramsay Santé pour l'Enseignement et la Recherche
